messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR for reserved pools onboarding. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Need a quick review on the Terraform snippet and autoscale wording.

 tessa: saw it, will review this afternoon. one question: do we use `isolation.decorator` or `isolation_decorator` in examples? I remember we standardized on snake_case for TF variables.

 cheng: it should be `isolation_decorator` (snake_case) in TF examples. current example in the PR uses kebab-case `isolation-decorator` which won't map to the module var.

 miguel: also noticed the autoscale wording references `burst_to_shared` which is deprecated. suggest using `burst_policy = "shared_fallback"` in examples. and the TF sample is missing the provider region so `terraform apply` fails in CI.

 alex: thanks — can one of you paste the corrected TF snippet here so I can include it in the PR?

 miguel: sure, here's a minimal corrected snippet: 

 ```hcl
 module "redwood_dedicated_pool" {
   source = "redwood/dedicated/gcp"
   name   = "prod-reserved"
   region = var.region
   isolation_decorator = "corp-team"
   autoscale = {
     min = 2
     target = 10
     policy = "balanced"
     burst_policy = "shared_fallback"
   }
 }
 ```

 tess: thx — I also updated the Python SDK snippet in the PR: replaced `client.create_pool(..., pref='isolation-decorator')` with `client.create_pool(..., isolation_decorator='corp-team')`. pushed the change as a separate commit.

 docs-bot: Link check failed for https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/reserved-pools#isolation -> 404 (reported by nightly crawler)

 alex: okay I'll patch the anchor and add a redirect. one more thing: the SLA blurb currently says `SLA: 99.95% availability during business hours` — legal wants the phrasing to be `Monthly uptime SLA: 99.95% for Reserved pools`.

 cheng: agree, use exact wording: `Monthly uptime SLA: 99.95% for Reserved pools.` also add pointer to SLA matrix: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/sla#reserved-pools

 tess: LGTM. i'll hold for alex's link patch and then merge.

 alex: done — updated TF snippet in the PR, fixed the anchor and added redirect. squashed commits and updated PR description. tagging @tess @cheng for merge.

 tess: merging now :shipit:
